band-formats.answer: The 2002 PERFORM has two formats, out-of-line and inline (§2002:14.8.27.1), with one unbanded syntax-rule list; they are 2023 formats 1 and 2 phrase for phrase (2023 adds UNTIL EXIT and format 3, both absent from 2002). The 2023 band FORMATS 1 AND 2 therefore reaches every 2002 PERFORM; no 2002 format falls outside it. SR7 governs the BY literals of varying-phrase in either format.
